Sandbox_KentuckyFighter_WhiteFighterChan: Chance, in percent, of each zombie or zombie corpse in the world spawning dressed as White Fighter (classic karateka: sleeveless white kimono with a black belt, white judo pants and a red headband). 0 = never; 1 = 1 in every 100 zombies; 0.1 = 1 in every 1000.
Sandbox_KentuckyFighter_RedFighterChance: Chance, in percent, of each zombie or zombie corpse in the world spawning dressed as Red Fighter (classic karateka: sleeveless red kimono with a black belt and red judo pants). 0 = never; 1 = 1 in every 100 zombies; 0.1 = 1 in every 1000.
Sandbox_KentuckyFighter_RedCommanderChan: Chance, in percent, of each zombie or zombie corpse in the world spawning dressed as Red Commander (imposing commander: red officer cap, red military tunic with shoulder armor, wine-red breeches and knee-high armored boots). 0 = never; 1 = 1 in every 100 zombies; 0.1 = 1 in every 1000.
